cues.en: the Walt Disney Company's board of directors approved My Magic Plus with a budget of around $1,000,000,000.
cues.zh: 2月，华特迪士尼公司的董事会批准了 My Magic Plus 项目，预算约为 10 亿美元。

cues.en: Iger reportedly sternly told Stags, quote, this better work, which became a mantra for the entire team. Stags was under enormous pressure to deliver on a project that didn't really make the parks or Disney money. Now when I put this in, does money immediately begin flowing out of my checking account?
cues.zh: 据报道，Iger 严厉地对 Stags 说，引述如下：“这最好能奏效”，这句话成了整个团队的座右铭。Stags 面临着巨大的压力，要交付一个实际上并不能为乐园或迪士尼赚大钱的项目。现在，当我把这个放进去时，钱会立即从我的支票账户里流出吗？

cues.en: If it's working correctly, yes. Yes. Yeah. In a shocking twist, most of the rhetoric surrounding Nextgen and My Magic Plus internally was not about the potential profit from the system. Those developing the new technology and even much of the executive team believed in the more altruistic benefits of the program. The ability to guarantee experiences for vacationers,
cues.zh: 如果它正常运作的话，是的。是的。对。在一个令人震惊的转折中，内部围绕 Nextgen 和 My Magic Plus 的大部分言论，并不是关于该系统带来的潜在利润。那些开发新技术的人，甚至许多高管团队，都相信该项目更具利他主义的好处。为度假者保证体验的能力，

cues.en: to simplify the experience of visiting the resort, to improve traffic flow and crowd control at the parks, to create an IT infrastructure that could be built on over the coming decades,
cues.zh: 简化度假村游览体验，改善乐园内的客流和人群控制，打造一个可在未来几十年在此基础上构建的 IT 基础设施，

cues.en: even to make cast members jobs easier so they could focus more on providing great interactions with guests. These were the key components of the pitch. This is not to say that there were not some ulterior motives.
cues.zh: 甚至让演职人员的工作更轻松，这样他们就能更专注于与游客进行美好的互动。这些都是推介的核心要素。这并不是说不存在一些不可告人的动机。

cues.en: Disney definitely wanted to impress with the program to establish themselves as a major player in the tech space, but this did not create a clear path to generate income. Apart from the new digital photo pass system, which had direct monetary benefits, the revenue that the billion dollar My Magic Plus overhaul would generate was almost entirely theoretical.
cues.zh: Disney 显然想通过这个项目让人刮目相看，确立自己在科技领域的重要地位，但这并没有创造出清晰的创收路径。除了新的数字照片通行证系统带来了直接的金钱收益外，这个耗资十亿美元的 My Magic Plus 大改造所能产生的收入几乎完全是理论上的。

cues.en: Maybe guests would think less about their purchases when using their x bands, which would then lead to more spending. Maybe the novelty of the X Band would encourage more people to stay at Walt Disney World resorts, which would increase revenue. Maybe the data collected from everyone's X Bands and account profiles could be leveraged in ways to increase spending. Maybe a few cast member positions could be automated with the system, which would save money. Maybe the traffic flow improvements would be so great that more guests could fit into the park. And the biggest maybe that the entire project was predicated on, maybe My Magic Plus would create such a wonderful experience for our guests that they would be more likely to return and more likely to recommend that others visit. Sure, the end goal was to increase revenue, but Disney's focus was on improving the guest experience and hoping that the money would come as a result. This optimistic and almost quaint approach seemed to be at odds with the $1,000,000,000
cues.zh: 也许游客在使用 X 手环时会更少考虑花费，从而消费更多。也许 X 手环的新奇感会鼓励更多人在 Walt Disney World 度假村住宿，从而增加收入。也许从每个人的 X 手环和账户资料中收集的数据可以被用来增加消费。也许一些演职人员岗位可以通过该系统实现自动化，从而节省开支。也许人流改善效果会非常好，让更多游客能容纳进园区。而整个项目所基于的最大“也许”，就是 My Magic Plus 会为游客创造如此美妙的体验，以至于他们更愿意再来，也更愿意推荐别人来。当然，最终目标是增加收入，但 Disney 的重点是改善游客体验，并希望钱会随之而来。这种乐观甚至近乎天真的做法似乎与 1,000,000,000

cues.en: price tag, but Eiger, Stags, Roussullo, and other executives believed in the program enough to keep it going. Others throughout Disney had a much different opinion, which quickly led to infighting. Disney hired multiple tech contractors to manufacture and deliver much of the My Magic Plus technology,
cues.zh: 美元的价格标签格格不入，但 Eiger、Stags、Roussullo 和其他高管对这个项目足够有信心，坚持推进下去。Disney 内部其他人的看法则大不相同，这很快导致了内斗。Disney 雇了多家技术承包商来制造和交付 My Magic Plus 的大部分技术，

cues.en: and it was an open secret in the tech industry that they hired subpar firms that saw the project as a cash cow, overcharging and under delivering.
cues.zh: 而科技行业内公开的秘密是，他们雇的是些平庸的公司，这些公司把这个项目视为摇钱树，收费过高却交付不足。

cues.en: These firms also did not get along with the park's IT team, especially when major issues were found with implementation.
cues.zh: 这些公司也和乐园的 IT 团队合不来，尤其是在实施过程中发现重大问题时。

cues.en: Walt Disney Imagineering was not all in on the My Magic Plus technology either. The parks hoped that the Imagineers would take advantage of the X Band technology to deliver unique experiences in attractions,
cues.zh: Walt Disney Imagineering 也并不完全支持 My Magic Plus 技术。乐园方面希望幻想工程师们能利用 X Band 技术，在游乐项目中带来独特体验，

cues.en: but Imagineering viewed the X Bands as a gimmick, and a risky one at that. Plus, placing X Band readers throughout the park's land so the guests could redeem fast passes clashed with the theming. Imagineer Joe Rody said, quote, if I'm supposed to be living with fairies, fairies don't have iPhones or MagicBands.
cues.zh: 但 Imagineering 认为 X Band 只是个噱头，而且还是有风险的噱头。再说，要在乐园各处安装 X Band 读取器，让游客能核销 FastPass，这和主题氛围相冲突。幻想工程师 Joe Rody 说：“如果我要和仙女一起生活，仙女可没有 iPhone 或 MagicBands。”

cues.en: The Imagineers ended up barely integrating the X Bands into new attractions,
cues.zh: 结果，幻想工程师们几乎没把 X Band 整合进新游乐项目，

cues.en: with Epcot's test track being one of the only real benefactors.
cues.zh: 其中 Epcot 的 Test Track 是少数真正受益者之一。

cues.en: What's FastPass Plus, you ask? Come on, I'll show you.
cues.zh: 你问 FastPass Plus 是什么？来吧，我带你看看。

cues.en: That
cues.zh: 那首歌

cues.en: is technically my second favorite FastPass parody song, but it's really not even a competition.
cues.zh: 严格来说是我第二喜欢的 FastPass 恶搞歌曲，但其实根本谈不上竞争。

cues.en: In January 2013, Disney officially announced the creation of My Magic Plus, along with the introduction of the new high-tech wristbands, now renamed to MagicBands.
cues.zh: 2013 年 1 月，Disney 正式宣布推出 My Magic Plus，同时推出新的高科技腕带，并改名为 MagicBands。

cues.en: X Pass was also announced, renamed to FastPass Plus. System had been altered slightly, and it would allow guests to book three Fast Passes in advance. This static number applied to all four parks, rather than X Passes proposed dynamic system. As rumored, guests staying at Walt Disney World Resort Hotels would get early access to Fast Passes. Hotel guests would be able to book their FastPasses sixty days in advance, while everyone else could book theirs thirty days in advance. When guests went to book their FastPasses, they were given a list of attractions that had FastPass available. They then selected three of them, no more, no less. If the guests didn't select three, the system picked two at random. After the selections were made, the computer would intelligently create multiple itineraries that guests could choose from. After this, guests could still edit the selections, either by changing the time of the Fast Pass reservation,
cues.zh: X Pass 也一并公布，并改名为 FastPass Plus。系统做了小幅调整，允许游客提前预订三个 FastPass。这个固定数量适用于全部四个乐园，而不是 X Pass 提议的动态系统。正如传闻所说，入住 Walt Disney World Resort 酒店的游客可以更早预订 FastPass。酒店住客可提前六十天预订 FastPass，其他人则提前三十天。游客预订 FastPass 时，会看到一份提供 FastPass 的游乐项目列表。然后他们从中选三个，不多不少。如果游客没选满三个，系统会随机挑两个。完成选择后，计算机会智能生成多个行程供游客选择。之后，游客仍可编辑选择，要么更改 FastPass 预约时间，

cues.en: or by selecting another attraction within the initial attraction's time frame. Fast Passes were now redeemed with Magic Bands or guest park tickets, but during the initial rollout, paper Fast Pass kiosks would still be available. My Magic Plus was introduced in phases throughout 2013 and early twenty fourteen, and issues with the system were immediate, apparent, and overwhelming.
cues.zh: 要么在初始项目的时间段内选择另一个项目。现在 FastPass 通过 MagicBand 或游客乐园门票核销，但在最初推广期间，纸质 FastPass 自助机仍会保留。My Magic Plus 在 2013 年全年到 2014 年初分阶段推出，而系统问题立刻出现、显而易见，而且铺天盖地。

cues.en: Reportedly, those on the rollout team and IT pleaded to executives to pull the plug, as the tech was making operations much worse, to which executives essentially responded,
cues.zh: 据报道，负责推广的团队成员和IT部门曾恳求高管们叫停项目，因为这项技术让运营变得更糟，而高管们的回应基本上是：

cues.en: we know, but we're in too deep. Spotty WiFi, malfunctioning MagicBand readers, website crashes, an at times unusable mobile app, and many more issues plagued the system, and thus the resort. There are too many issues with My Magic Plus to discuss, but if you're curious, here are a few.
cues.zh: 我们知道，但我们已经陷得太深了。WiFi信号不稳定、MagicBand读取器故障、网站崩溃、移动应用有时无法使用，还有更多问题困扰着整个系统，进而影响了整个度假区。My Magic Plus的问题多到难以尽述，但如果你好奇的话，这里列举几个。

cues.en: The biggest disappointment with the system was that the tech was so broken that it was never able to take the guest experience to the next level. At best, it worked, but it never impressed in the ways that the team had hoped, and many of the more ambitious plans for the technology, such as leveraging data to give guests recommendations
cues.zh: 这个系统最大的遗憾在于，技术太过破碎，始终未能将游客体验提升到新的高度。最好的情况也不过是勉强能用，但从未达到团队期望的惊艳效果，而且许多更具雄心的技术计划，比如利用数据为游客提供推荐，

cues.en: or even being able to communicate to cast members via magic bands that it was a guest's birthday, could never be implemented,
cues.zh: 甚至能通过MagicBand向演职人员传达某位游客正在过生日，都始终无法实现，

cues.en: because IT was too busy keeping the entire system afloat to ever have time to take it to the next step. Most damning, by and large, cast members hated it, and it made many positions much more frustrating to work at. It automated few, if any jobs, and because of the issues, Disney had to triple the size of its customer support department.
cues.zh: 因为IT部门忙于维持整个系统的运转，根本没有时间将它推进到下一步。最要命的是，演职人员普遍讨厌它，它让许多岗位的工作变得更加令人沮丧。它几乎没实现什么工作的自动化，而且由于各种问题，迪士尼不得不将客服部门规模扩大了两倍。

cues.en: Despite all of the issues, Disney publicly labeled My Magic Plus a success, and Stags even said that thanks to the system's ability to distribute guests more evenly throughout the parks, Magic Kingdom's maximum capacity was increased by 5,000 people. Although it is unclear whether this has anything to do with the new Fantasyland expansion that also debuted around this time. Stags was determined to be the winner of Eiger's competition, and Roussullo stepped down from CFO in 2015,
cues.zh: 尽管问题重重，迪士尼仍公开将My Magic Plus标榜为成功之作，Stags甚至表示，得益于系统更均匀地将游客分布到各园区的能力，魔法王国的最大承载量增加了5000人。不过，这是否与同期亮相的新梦幻世界扩建有关，尚不清楚。Stags被认定为艾格内部竞争的胜出者，而Roussullo于2015年卸任CFO，

cues.en: while Stags was promoted to chief operating officer, with Bob Chapek,
cues.zh: Stags则被提升为首席运营官，同时Bob Chapek，

cues.en: the president of Disney's consumer products division, promoted to head of the parks.
cues.zh: 即迪士尼消费品部门总裁，被提升为乐园业务负责人。

cues.en: Stags would unexpectedly leave the company the following year, with no confirmed reason for his departure.
cues.zh: Stags 在第二年毫无预兆地离开了公司，其离职原因并未得到证实。

cues.en: Overall, MyMagic plus and MagicBand streamlined the guest experience as much as it stalled it. Some guests loved it, some guests hated it, and others simply didn't care. In many ways, the introduction of the technology was a wash,
cues.zh: 总的来说，MyMagic plus 和 MagicBand 在简化游客体验的同时，也让体验停滞不前。有的游客非常喜欢，有的深恶痛绝，还有的则完全不在乎。在很多方面，这项技术的引入可以说是毫无成效，
一项耗资十亿美元的

cues.en: wash. But what about the new program's headlining feature,
cues.zh: 失败投资。但新项目的主打功能又如何呢？

cues.en: FastPass Plus?
cues.zh: FastPass Plus？

cues.en: By the end of its life in 2014,
cues.zh: 到 2014 年其生命周期结束时，

cues.en: the original paper FastPass system was still operating off of a Windows software from the late nineties. So the update in technology,
cues.zh: 最初的纸质 FastPass 系统依然在运行一个九十年代末的 Windows 软件。因此，这次技术升级

cues.en: as buggy as it could be, was definitely a welcome one. But FastPass Plus was much more than its touch points. It was an entirely new system, and like the original FastPass,
cues.zh: 尽管偶尔会出现各种漏洞，但绝对是受欢迎的。不过，FastPass Plus 的意义远不止其触控点。它是一个全新的系统，和最初的 FastPass 一样，

cues.en: it was a huge learning curve for guests. The new system could only be accessed on the website, on the My Disney Experience app, or with a cast member at one of the FastPass plus kiosks set up throughout the park. During the initial rollout, this led to huge lines for the FastPass plus kiosks.
cues.zh: 对游客来说需要一个很长的学习适应期。新系统只能通过网站、My Disney Experience 应用，或是园区内设置的 FastPass plus 自助机旁的工作人员来访问。在最初推出期间，这导致 FastPass plus 自助机前排起了长队。

cues.en: Or to put it another way, there was a line to get the pass to skip the lines. While guests adjusted to the new system, the system itself was undergoing constant adjustment. In November 2013, Epcot and Hollywood Studios transitioned to a tiered FastPass plus system, in which the park's most popular attractions were separated from the rest, and only one popular attraction could be held at a time. In February 2014,
cues.zh: 换句话说，排队是为了拿到免排队的通行证。正当游客们适应新系统时，系统本身也在经历不断的调整。2013 年 11 月，Epcot 和 Hollywood Studios 过渡到了分级制的 FastPass plus 系统，园内最热门的景点被单独列出，且一次只能预约一个热门景点。2014 年 2 月，

cues.en: the transition to FastPass Plus was complete, and all paper FastPass kiosks were removed from the park. Rumoredly,
cues.zh: 向 FastPass Plus 的过渡完成，园内所有纸质 FastPass 自助机都被移除。据传，

cues.en: the speed of the transition was part of an effort to force guest adoption of the new technology in order to prove its efficacy. Two months later, the system was altered once again to allow guests to receive additional fast passes after they redeemed their first three.
cues.zh: 这种快速过渡是为了迫使游客接受新技术，从而证明其有效性。两个月后，系统再次进行了修改，允许游客在兑换完前三张 FastPass 后获取额外的 FastPass。

cues.en: Once guests redeemed their third fast pass for the day, they could go to a fast pass plus kiosk and choose one additional pass. After they redeemed this additional one, they could select another and repeat the process until the end of the day. The next major change would not come until mid twenty sixteen, when the itinerary system was dropped, and now guests had to choose each of their FastPass times themselves. This also removed the three initial FastPass rule, allowing guests to select only one or two FastPasses without forcing them to start with three. Finally, guests can now choose their additional FastPasses from the My Disney Experience app, rather than only at the kiosks.
cues.zh: 当游客兑换完当天第三张快速通行证后，就可以去快速通行证自助机再选一张。兑换完这张额外的通行证后，他们还可以继续选，一直重复这个过程直到一天结束。下一个重大改变直到2016年中期才到来，当时行程系统被取消了，现在游客必须自己选择每个 FastPass 的时间。这也取消了最初的三张 FastPass 规则，允许游客只选择一张或两张 FastPass，而不强制他们必须从三张开始。最后，游客现在可以直接从 My Disney Experience 应用中选择他们的额外 FastPass，而不局限于在自助机上办理。

cues.en: It would not be until 2017 that Disneyland would update their FastPass system.
cues.zh: 直到 2017 年，迪士尼乐园才更新了他们的 FastPass 系统。

cues.en: Rumorly, Disneyland was set to receive My Magic Plus, MagicBands,
cues.zh: 据传，迪士尼乐园原本准备引入 My Magic Plus、MagicBands、

cues.en: FastPass Plus, and all, but the major issues with the system resulted in the expansion being canceled. Instead, Disneyland would receive an entirely different system called MaxPass.
cues.zh: FastPass Plus 等全套系统，但该系统出现的重大问题导致这一扩建计划被取消。取而代之的是，迪士尼乐园引入了一个完全不同的系统，叫做 MaxPass。

cues.en: For $10 a day, visitors could book FastPasses from their phone, except they could only do so when inside the park. Like Paper FastPass, users could only receive one FastPass at a time, unable to receive additional passes until the first return window had arrived, or ninety minutes after the initial pass was booked.
cues.zh: 游客只需每天支付 10 美元，就可以在手机上预订 FastPass，不过前提是他们必须身处园区内。就像纸质 FastPass 一样，用户一次只能获得一张 FastPass，在第一个入园时间窗口到来之前，或者在最初预订的通行证生效九十分钟后，才能获得额外的通行证。

cues.en: The system received mixed reviews upon announcement, but after installation,
cues.zh: 系统在公布时评价褒贬不一，但安装之后，

cues.en: many warmed up to it, believing that MaxPass was superior to FastPass Plus, which by this point was the subject of a heated debate.
cues.zh: 许多人逐渐接受了它，认为MaxPass优于FastPass Plus，而后者此时正是激烈争论的焦点。

cues.en: FastPass Plus was a divisive program, and many have strong opinions on it. There are pros and cons to the system, so I'd like to take this moment to examine the biggest ones. Before we get into this, I wanna mention that we will not be discussing or factoring in other ways guests are able to cut the line, such as with tour guides or the guest assistance program. These systems have their own complex histories during this period that, while interesting and important,
cues.zh: FastPass Plus是一个引发分歧的项目，许多人对它有强烈的看法。这个系统有利有弊，所以我想借此机会审视一下其中最大的几个利弊。在开始之前，我想说明一下，我们不会讨论或计入游客插队的其他方式，比如通过导游或guest assistance program。这些系统在这一时期各有其复杂的历史，虽然有趣且重要，

cues.en: are not factored in to this list or this discussion on FastPass in general. That said, here are some of the pros and cons to FastPass Plus.
cues.zh: 但不会计入这份清单，也不会纳入本次关于FastPass的整体讨论。话虽如此，以下是FastPass Plus的一些利弊。

cues.en: Pro number one, you get to skip the line more, obviously.
cues.zh: 优点一，显然，你可以更多地跳过排队。

cues.en: Pro number two, improve traffic flow throughout the park. One of the biggest downsides to the original FastPass system was that guests had to travel to an attraction's entrance to obtain a paper FastPass
cues.zh: 优点二，改善了园区内的人流。原版FastPass系统最大的缺点之一是，游客必须前往景点的入口领取纸质FastPass，

cues.en: just to return to the same location when it was time to ride. This backtracking was causing major traffic flow issues, so allowing guests to make reservations from their phone eliminated this unnecessary foot traffic. Plus, it was more convenient for guests. Pro number three, reduction in length of stay. As park attendance climbed throughout the early two thousands, fast passes for major attractions ran out earlier in the day. So in turn, guests arrived earlier in the day, resulting in more people arriving in the morning and staying for longer, which increased the amount of people in each park. With FastPass Plus, guests would know three of their FastPass reservations before arriving,
cues.zh: 然后在乘车时间回到同一地点。这种来回折返造成了严重的人流问题，所以允许游客通过手机预约消除了这些不必要的步行人流。此外，这对游客来说也更方便。优点三，缩短了停留时间。随着两千年代初期园区客流量攀升，热门景点的快速通行证在当天更早就会发完。于是游客更早到达，导致早上到达并停留更久的人更多，增加了每个园区的人数。有了FastPass Plus，游客在到达前就能知道三个FastPass预约，

cues.en: which would encourage guests that had FastPasses for later in the day not to arrive until later, thus relieving morning and midday crowds. Plus, guests no longer had to wake up early to rope drop fast passes, allowing for a more relaxing vacation.
cues.zh: 这会鼓励那些FastPass时间较晚的游客晚些到达，从而缓解早晨和中午的拥挤。此外，游客不再需要早起抢快速通行证，让假期更加轻松。

cues.en: Con number one, irrelevant fast passes. In the mad dash to add as many attractions to the fast pass system as possible, the implementation of certain attractions was less thought out than others. For instance, fast passes for Monsters Inc. Glathfloor and Muppet Vision three d rarely saved guests any time, as these attractions were theater shows that held guests in large waiting areas before the next showing. Guests who had FastPasses for these types of attractions soon learned that all their FastPass did was give them a different entrance to the same giant room where they had to wait with other guests. Con number two, long
cues.zh: 第一个缺点，不相关的快速通行证。在疯狂地为快速通行证系统添加尽可能多景点的过程中，某些景点的实施考虑得不如其他景点周到。例如，怪兽电力公司笑声楼层和布偶视觉3D的快速通行证很少能为游客节省时间，因为这些景点是剧场表演，会在下一场演出前让游客在大型等候区等待。持有这类景点快速通行证的游客很快发现，他们的快速通行证只是让他们从不同的入口进入同一个巨大的房间，在那里他们必须与其他游客一起等待。第二个缺点，排长队。

cues.en: lines. Many using FastPass Plus reported waiting longer after redeeming their FastPass than they did with the original FastPass system. The original intention of FastPass was for guests to wait no more than fifteen minutes before boarding. But with FastPass Plus, guests were now having to wait over half an hour at certain points. This was in part due to the fact that FastPass Plus was basically guaranteeing that an attraction would be operating sixty days in advance. As previously explained, paper FastPass had a built in response to downtimes, or at the very least, a ride operator could throw a bunch of fast passes in the trash to give operations some wiggle room. This was much more difficult with fast pass plus. When an attraction went down, it might have already had an entire day's worth of fast passes distributed.
cues.zh: 许多使用FastPass Plus的人报告说，兑换快速通行证后等待的时间比使用原始快速通行证系统时更长。快速通行证的初衷是让游客在登车前等待不超过十五分钟。但有了FastPass Plus，游客在某些时段现在不得不等待超过半小时。部分原因是FastPass Plus基本上保证了景点会提前六十天运营。如前所述，纸质快速通行证对停运有内置的应对机制，或者至少，游乐设施操作员可以把一堆快速通行证扔进垃圾桶，给运营一些回旋余地。而使用FastPass Plus则困难得多。当一个景点停运时，可能已经分配了整整一天的快速通行证。

cues.en: If the downtime was significant, anyone with fast passes during the downtime were given an any use fast pass with which they could use on any ride they chose, which backed up fast pass lines at other attractions throughout the park. If the ride was delayed, but did not completely shut down, this caused a backup in the fast pass line for that ride. When there was a backup, the FastPass to standby ratio had to be altered to get the FastPass line under control. This was the same compensation plan as paper FastPass, but the new system seemed to be dispersing any used
cues.zh: 如果停运时间较长，在此期间持有 FastPass 的游客都会获得一张通用 FastPass，可以任选项目使用，结果导致园区内其他项目的 FastPass 通道大排长龙。如果设施只是延误而没有完全关闭，则会导致该项目本身的 FastPass 通道发生拥堵。一旦出现拥堵，就必须调整 FastPass 与普通排队的放行比例，以控制住 FastPass 队伍。这与纸质 FastPass 时代的补偿方案相同，但新系统发放通用通行证的频率似乎……

cues.en: frequently, leading to Disney eventually putting limits on these passes.
cues.zh: 这经常导致迪士尼最终对这些通行证进行限制。

cues.en: Con number three, the fast pass to standby ratio.
cues.zh: 第三个缺点，快速通道与备用的比例。

cues.en: We have yet to discuss the fast pass to standby ratio in detail. It is no secret that of the two lines, the Fast Pass line was given priority over the standby line. In fact, that's the whole point. The question is how much was Fast Pass favored over standby? There's no definitive answer to this, because it was different for every attraction and ultimately up to the cast members stationed at the merge point. Bruce Lebow recounted that this was the most difficult position to train, and it was the key position to getting the original FastPass system to work. The cast member not only had to keep the attractions ratio steady, but they had to manage the expectations and frustrations of two very different lines of people experiencing
cues.zh: 我们尚未详细讨论快速通行证与普通排队通道的比例。众所周知，在这两条队伍中，快速通行证通道的优先级高于普通排队通道。事实上，这正是它的核心所在。问题是，快速通行证受到的优待究竟比普通排队多多少？对此并没有一个确定的答案，因为每个景点的比例都不同，最终取决于驻守在汇流点的演职人员。Bruce Lebow 回忆说，这是最难培训的岗位，也是让最初的 FastPass 系统得以运作的关键岗位。演职人员不仅要保持景点的人流比例稳定，还要应付两支体验截然不同的队伍中人群的期望与挫败感。

cues.en: two very different ways. The FastPass to standby ratio cited on the original FastPass patent was eighty twenty, or in other words, for every four FastPass guests, one standby guest was let through. This is consistent with cast member and guest recollections of the system at the time. The four to one ratio remained standard after the transition to FastPass plus, but with backups occurring much more frequently, cast members at merge points had to modify the FastPass to standby disparity more often. There were three phases cast members had to go through. Phase one was standard operating procedure with a four to one ratio. If there was a backup in the FastPass line, cast members would go to phase two, which was a 20 to one ratio.
cues.zh: 两种截然不同的方式。原版 FastPass 专利中提到的 FastPass 与 standby 比例是 80 比 20，换句话说，每放行四名 FastPass 游客，才放行一名 standby 游客。这与当时演职人员和游客对该系统的回忆一致。过渡到 FastPass Plus 后，四比一的比例仍是标准，但由于积压出现得频繁得多，合流点的演职人员不得不更频繁地调整 FastPass 与 standby 的差距。演职人员要经历三个阶段。第一阶段是四比一比例的标准操作流程。如果 FastPass 队列出现积压，演职人员会进入第二阶段，也就是二十比一的比例。

cues.en: And if the backup was significant enough, phase three would be initiated,
cues.zh: 如果积压情况足够严重，就会启动第三阶段，

cues.en: which was for every one standby guest, 100 FastPass guests were let through. Once the FastPass line was under control, cast members would return to phase one, but the disparity of phase two and three was infuriating to guests waiting in the standby queue, which during these phases would almost completely stop.
cues.zh: 即每放行 1 个普通排队游客，就放行 100 个 FastPass 游客。一旦 FastPass 队伍得到控制，演职人员就会回到第一阶段，但第二和第三阶段造成的巨大差距惹怒了普通队伍的游客，在这些阶段中，普通队伍几乎完全停滞不前。

cues.en: There was also a psychological gamble to Fastpass.
cues.zh: FastPass 背后其实也存在一场心理博弈。

cues.en: Disney was banking on the idea that guests would not remember the three or four times they were cut in line. They would just remember the one time they got to cut the line. This gamble seemed to pay off, but they were also working against another issue with the psychology of queuing. Now that Fastpass was slowing down the standby line, the pace at which guests moved through the queue was much slower. In most cases, people prefer to spend twenty minutes walking at a steady pace rather than spend twenty minutes standing still, but the latter was now happening frequently on FastPass attractions.
cues.zh: 迪士尼赌的是，游客不会记住自己被插队三四次的经历，只会记住自己有一次插别人的队。这场博弈似乎收到了成效，但他们同时也在应对排队心理学的另一个问题。既然 FastPass 让普通队伍慢了下来，游客在队伍中移动的节奏就变得慢得多了。大多数人宁愿花二十分钟以稳定的步伐行走，也不愿意花二十分钟原地站着，但后者现在在有 FastPass 的项目中经常发生。

cues.en: In the pre FastPass days, lines often stretched out of an attraction's dedicated queue, But it is important to remember that back then, these lines were moving three, four, or five times as fast. With fast pass, guests found that the amount of people waiting in the standby line was less than before, despite the wait time being the same or longer. Con number four, fast pass availability.
cues.zh: 在没有 FastPass 的年代，队伍经常延伸到项目专属排队区外面，但必须记住，那时候队伍移动的速度是现在的三倍、四倍甚至五倍。有了 FastPass 后，游客发现普通排队的人数比以前少了，尽管等待时间还是一样长甚至更长。第四大缺点，FastPass 的可用性。

cues.en: After guests became accustomed to the fast pass plus system, it did not take long for them to figure out the best ways to use it. In turn, fast pass availability was running out extremely fast for popular rides. Practically every day of the year, popular attractions would run out of fast pass availability completely before the day of operation.
cues.zh: 游客们习惯了快速通行+系统后，很快就摸索出了最佳使用方法。相应地，热门项目的快速通行名额消耗得极快。几乎一年中的每一天，热门景点在运营日到来之前，快速通行名额就已全部发完。

cues.en: This was the case for five attractions at the Magic Kingdom, three at Epcot, three at Hollywood Studios, two at Animal Kingdom, and four meet and greets throughout the resort. This meant that nearly 17 experiences were out of fast passes before guests even arrived to the park. This prompted Disney to hold back a small amount of fast passes until the day of, where they would then drop these held back passes at different points throughout the day. This also gave them the option to not drop these additional passes at all if the attraction was experiencing downtime.
cues.zh: 魔法王国里有五个景点如此，Epcot三个、好莱坞影城三个、动物王国两个，以及度假区内四个见面会。这意味着近17个体验项目在游客入园之前快速通行就已发完。这促使迪士尼预留少量快速通行名额到当天，然后在一天中的不同时段放出这些预留名额。这也让他们可以选择在景点停运时完全不放出这些额外名额。

cues.en: Still, unless a guest got lucky and snagged a fast pass during one of these random drops, or after another guest modified or canceled theirs, if they wanted a fast pass for a popular ride, they had to plan in advance.
cues.zh: 不过，除非游客运气好，在这些随机放出的时段抢到了快速通行，或者在其他游客修改或取消后捡漏，否则若想拿到热门项目的快速通行，就得提前规划。

cues.en: Which leads me to pro number four and con number five, planning.
cues.zh: 这就引出了第四个优点和第五个缺点：规划。

cues.en: Many people love planning their Disney trips, and do a lot of research and groundwork beforehand.
cues.zh: 很多人喜欢规划迪士尼之旅，会提前做大量研究和准备工作。

cues.en: My Magic Plus and FastPass Plus significantly increased the amount of planning necessary to have a consistently good experience at Walt Disney World. Fast Pass Plus was supposed to give guests the option to plan their trip in advance, but in practice, the system forced guests to plan their trip in advance or risk not getting to experience the most popular attractions without an extreme standby wait time. Hotel guests could book an entire trip's worth of FastPasses sixty days out from their check-in date. This allowed some guests to book as many as seventy days in advance,
cues.zh: My Magic Plus和FastPass Plus大幅增加了在沃尔特迪士尼世界获得稳定良好体验所需的规划量。FastPass Plus本应让游客可以选择提前规划行程，但实际上，该系统迫使游客必须提前规划，否则就可能无法体验最热门的景点，除非愿意接受极长的 standby 排队时间。酒店住客可以从入住日期起算60天前预订整个行程的FastPass。这让一些游客可以提前多达70天预订，

cues.en: resulting in certain attractions like Slinky Dog Dash at Hollywood Studios, and Flight of Passage at Animal Kingdom running out of fast passes even before the sixty day mark. Securing these fast passes practically became a sport, and everyone had tips and tricks to snag those passes. Alright. So we're gonna start with prepping you need to do beforehand. So you get three FastPass plus reservations per day. So once you hit the sixty day mark from your first night at your hotel, you can actually go on and book FastPasses for the whole length of your stay. Start with the last day of your vacation first. So the further out you can make it, the more likely you're able to get it. Also, if you take a longer trip, you're more likely to get it too. So if you need an excuse to take a longer trip, there you have it. So on my sixty mark day, I log on to my Disney experience,
cues.zh: 导致好莱坞影城的Slinky Dog Dash和动物王国的Flight of Passage等某些景点甚至在60天节点之前快速通行就已发完。抢这些快速通行几乎成了一项运动，每个人都有抢票的技巧和窍门。好，我们先从你需要提前做的准备开始。你每天可以预订三个FastPass+。所以一旦到了你入住酒店第一晚起算的60天节点，你就可以直接去预订整个住宿期间的FastPass。先从假期的最后一天开始订。你能订得越远，抢到的可能性就越大。另外，如果你行程更长，也更容易抢到。所以如果你需要一个理由来安排更长的旅行，这就是了。在我第60天节点那天，我登录My Disney Experience，

cues.en: and I can start making FastPass elections at 7AM
cues.zh: 我可以早上7点开始抢 FastPass

cues.en: Eastern Standard Time
cues.zh: 东部标准时间

cues.en: or 6AM Central Standard Time, which is where I live. Because you wanna make sure that you are logged in about five minutes before
cues.zh: 或者中部标准时间早上6点，也就是我住的地方。因为你要确保在

cues.en: your FastPass
cues.zh: FastPass

cues.en: window opens.
cues.zh: 开放时间前大约五分钟登录。

cues.en: If at all possible, book them early in the day. That way you can get more FastPasses for different parts later in the day. You save that first hour of the day to ride some of the smaller rides,
cues.zh: 如果可以的话，尽量在当天早些时候预订。这样你之后就能抢到更多不同项目的 FastPass。把当天第一个小时留出来玩一些小项目，

cues.en: but then you try to set up your three FastPasses as soon as possible after that hour as close as possible together. I have filled in a vague idea of what I want to do.
cues.zh: 然后在这一小时结束后尽快安排你的三个 FastPass，时间尽量挨在一起。我已经大致填好了我想玩的项目。

cues.en: I make a fast pass plus list with all of the days, times, and rides I'm hoping to reserve. All it takes is some luck.
cues.zh: 我列了一个 FastPass Plus 清单，写上所有我想预订的日期、时间和项目。这全靠运气。

cues.en: That is a huge part of it. Please do not be thinking that this is like a super guarantee.
cues.zh: 运气占了很大一部分。请别以为这就像超级保险。

cues.en: So I guarantee you by the time your thirty day window comes up for off property guests...
cues.zh: 所以我向你保证，等到你的三十天窗口开放给非园区住宿游客时……

cues.en: Flight of passage. Flight of passage. Slinky dog. Gone. Seven dwarfs. Gone. Keep checking the app. Seriously,
cues.zh: 阿凡达飞行通道。阿凡达飞行通道。弹簧狗。没了。七个小矮人。没了。继续刷 app。说真的，

cues.en: keep refreshing refreshing refreshing.
cues.zh: 不停地刷新刷新刷新。

cues.en: Last minute fast passes pop up all the time. You'll be able to click hour by hour. And if you just keep clicking hour by hour, it will reload and reload and reload and reload. So that's called pounding the app by seasoned veterans of Disney World. And there are also tickets that are available,
cues.zh: 最后一刻的 FastPass 随时会冒出来。你可以逐个小时点。只要你不停地逐个小时点，它就会一遍遍重新加载。迪士尼老手把这叫做猛刷 app。另外还有一些票是可供选择的，

cues.en: like after 5PM tickets.
cues.zh: 比如下午5点之后的票。

cues.en: Okay? What you can do is buy these tickets and essentially what that gains you is three extra fast passes. And I would put this under a dummy name on and then what you can do is reuse it the next day because you never entered the park with this.
cues.zh: 好的，你可以这样做：买这些票，本质上你得到的是三次额外的快速通行。我会把它挂在一个假名字下，然后第二天你可以重复使用，因为你从未用这个进过园。

cues.en: And I think that's it. We did it. Good. We did it.
cues.zh: 我想就这些了。我们做到了。很好。我们做到了。

cues.en: Some savvy guests that knew how to use the system loved the new FastPass, and the extra planning was a welcome activity, adding even more anticipation to their upcoming trip, while also guaranteeing certain experiences during it. Others knew how to use the system, but did so begrudgingly,
cues.zh: 一些懂行的游客知道如何使用这个系统，很喜欢新的FastPass，额外的规划是一种受欢迎的活动，为他们即将到来的旅行增添了更多期待，同时也保证了旅行中的某些体验。另一些人知道如何使用这个系统，但用得很不情愿，

cues.en: disliking the overplanning and longing for the days of flexibility.
cues.zh: 不喜欢过度规划，渴望过去那种灵活的日子。

cues.en: Many more guests did not know the tips and tricks of the system, and thus missed out on the most valuable FastPasses,
cues.zh: 更多得多的游客不知道这个系统的技巧和窍门，因此错过了最有价值的FastPass，

cues.en: leaving them with only one option if they wanted to experience these popular rides. Con number six, standby.
cues.zh: 如果他们想体验这些热门游乐设施，就只剩下一个选择。第六个缺点， standby。

cues.en: By far, the biggest complaint with FastPass plus is the belief that the new system drastically increased wait times throughout the park. When the system was first introduced, Haunted Mansion and Pirates of the Caribbean,
cues.zh: 到目前为止，对FastPass plus最大的抱怨是认为新系统大幅增加了整个园区的等待时间。当该系统首次推出时，Haunted Mansion和Pirates of the Caribbean，

cues.en: attractions that did not previously offer paper fast pass, reported consistently higher wait times. On the other end of the spectrum, Space Mountain and Expedition Everest saw their standby waits decrease slightly. As the system was fully implemented, standby waits appeared to be longer. And for years, fans have argued back and forth whether or not FastPass increases or decreases standby waits, increases or decreases overall waits,
cues.zh: 这些之前不提供纸质快速通行的景点，报告的等待时间持续偏高。另一方面，Space Mountain和Expedition Everest的standby等待时间略有下降。随着系统全面实施，standby等待时间似乎更长了。多年来，粉丝们一直争论不休，FastPass到底是增加还是减少了standby等待时间，增加还是减少了总体等待时间，

cues.en: or increases or decreases the amount of attractions a guest can experience in a day. Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 或者增加还是减少了游客一天内能体验的景点数量。不幸的是，

cues.en: it is nearly impossible to answer these questions.
cues.zh: 这些问题几乎不可能回答。

cues.en: Statistics like these have not been reported by Disney, and wait times before FastPass were not consistently recorded. And even if they were, it would be unfair for numerous reasons to compare these numbers. Even doing the math ourselves would be almost impossible.
cues.zh: 迪士尼没有公布过这类统计数据，而且 FastPass 出现之前的排队时间也没有进行过持续记录。即便有记录，由于种种原因，拿这些数据进行对比也是不公平的。甚至连我们自己去算一下几乎都是不可能的。

cues.en: The equations necessary to determine what a virtual queue system such as FastPass does to a theme park is much too complicated for a spreadsheet.
cues.zh: 要推算出像 FastPass 这样的虚拟排队系统对主题公园到底有什么影响，所需的公式太复杂了，根本不是电子表格能搞定的。

cues.en: In order to answer these questions, we would actually need to create a computer simulation, like one of the ones Bruce Laval created during his time at the company. Even then, this is no small task. Someone would need to pay an industrial engineer to create a complex computer simulation of a theme park, populated with agents, all with unique preferences,
cues.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我们实际上需要创建一个计算机模拟系统，就像 Bruce Laval 在该公司任职期间制作的那些模拟系统一样。即便如此，这也绝非易事。必须花钱请一位工业工程师来创建一个复杂的主题公园计算机模拟程序，里面要填充各种具有独特偏好的智能体，

cues.en: riding attractions of varying capacities and run times in order to compare and contrast wait times, number of rides ridden, and other factors with and without a virtual queue system just to get to the bottom of this ridiculously niche curiosity.
cues.zh: 它们去乘坐容量和运行时间各不相同的游乐设施，以便对比有无虚拟排队系统时的排队时间、游玩项目数量以及其他因素，从而彻底搞清楚这个荒谬的小众好奇心。

cues.en: Hey, everybody. I made a theme park in the computer.
cues.zh: 大家好。我在电脑里做了一个主题公园。

cues.en: Welcome to Shapeland,
cues.zh: 欢迎来到 Shapeland，

cues.en: where all the guests are dots and all the rides are shapes. Here's how it works.
cues.zh: 这里所有的游客都是点，所有的游乐设施都是形状。它是这样运作的。

cues.en: I decide how many people are going to visit the park each day. They then arrive based on an arrival schedule that is similar to that of a real theme park, with most of the guests arriving in the first few hours of the day and few guests arriving in the last few hours of the day. From there, each guest independently makes decisions on what they are going to do. To ensure variability,
cues.zh: 我来决定每天有多少人去公园游园。然后他们会根据类似于真实主题公园的入园时间表到达，大部分游客在入园的前几个小时到达，只有少数游客在最后几个小时到达。从那以后，每个游客都会独立决定他们要做什么。为了确保多样性，

cues.en: there are seven different archetypes of guests, ride enthusiast,
cues.zh: 游客分为七种不同的原型，过山车发烧友，

cues.en: ride fan,
cues.zh: 过山车迷，

cues.en: average tourist,
cues.zh: 普通游客，

cues.en: activity fan,
cues.zh: 活动迷，

cues.en: annual pass holder,
cues.zh: 年卡持有者，

cues.en: entitled annual pass holder,
cues.zh: 特权年卡持有者，

cues.en: and vlogger.
cues.zh: 以及视频博主。

cues.en: Each of these archetypes determines three factors.
cues.zh: 每个原型都决定三个因素。

cues.en: The first is stay time preference. This dictates how long the guest wants to stay at the park. For instance, the ride enthusiast archetype wants to stay at the park for nine hours, while the average tourist archetype only wants to stay around seven hours. The second factor is bulking point. The ride enthusiast has a bulking point of four hours,
cues.zh: 第一个是停留时间偏好，这决定了游客想在乐园里待多久。比如，过山车爱好者原型想待九个小时，而普通游客原型只想待七个小时左右。第二个因素是不耐受点，过山车爱好者的不耐受点是四小时，

cues.en: meaning that they refuse to ride a ride that has over a four hour wait. On the other hand, the average tourist refuses to wait more than two hours for a ride, the annual pass holder won't wait more than thirty minutes, and the vlogger won't wait more than fifteen.
cues.zh: 意思是他们拒绝乘坐排队超过四小时的游乐设施。而普通游客不愿等超过两小时，年卡持有者不愿等超过三十分钟，视频博主不愿等超过十五分钟。

cues.en: The third factor is attraction preference.
cues.zh: 第三个因素是景点偏好。

cues.en: This determines whether a guest wants to ride an attraction or do an activity, such as eat at a restaurant or go gift shopping. Obviously,
cues.zh: 这决定了游客是想玩游乐设施，还是做其他活动，比如去餐厅吃饭或买纪念品。显然，

cues.en: attractions, but the average tourist is more open to doing activities.
cues.zh: 主要是游乐设施，但普通游客更愿意参加其他活动。

cues.en: After a guest enters the park, they will begin flipping coins and rolling dice weighted based on their own preferences.
cues.zh: 游客进园后，会开始抛硬币、掷骰子，权重基于他们自己的偏好。

cues.en: For instance, this guest's name is Bernadotte. Bernadotte is the average tourist. They are open to both attractions and activities.
cues.zh: 比如这位游客叫 Bernadotte。Bernadotte 是普通游客，既愿意玩游乐设施，也愿意参加其他活动。

cues.en: They will only wait around two hours for a ride, and they will stay for seven hours. Once in the park, Bernadotte decides whether they want to do an attraction or an activity based on a weighted coin flip. Let's say they choose to do attraction. They then decide which attraction to do. Bernadotte's decision is now based on a weighted die roll. Each attraction in the park has a different popularity ranking, and the more popular the attraction, the more likely it is that Bernadotte wants to ride it. Let's say Bernadotte decides to ride Shapeland's most popular attraction,
cues.zh: 他们只愿意为游乐设施等两小时左右，并且会待七个小时。进园后，Bernadotte 通过加权抛硬币决定是玩游乐设施还是参加活动。假设他们选择玩游乐设施，接着要决定玩哪个。Bernadotte 的决定现在基于加权掷骰子。乐园里每个设施都有不同的人气排名，设施越热门，Bernadotte 越可能想玩。假设 Bernadotte 决定玩 Shapeland 最热门的设施，

cues.en: the triangle. Since Shapeland is currently operating off the original FastPass system, Bernadotte first looks at the posted standby wait time. If the wait time is under thirty minutes, they join the standby line. If it is over thirty minutes, Bernadotte will check if the attraction has FastPass.
cues.zh: 三角形。由于 Shapeland 目前沿用最初的 FastPass 系统，Bernadotte 先看公布的普通排队等候时间。如果等候时间低于三十分钟，他们就排普通队。如果超过三十分钟，Bernadotte 会查看该设施是否有 FastPass。

cues.en: If it doesn't, whether it be because the attraction doesn't offer it, or because there are no more available for the day, Bernadotte will make sure that the current standby wait is less than their bulking point. If it is, they will join the standby line. If it isn't, they will go back to the hub and decide to do a different attraction. In the case that the attraction does offer FastPass and still has some available,
cues.zh: 如果没有，无论是因为该项目不提供，还是当天的配额已用完，Bernadotte 都会先确认当前的普通等候时间是否低于其放弃排队的阈值。如果是，他们就会加入普通排队；如果不是，就会返回中心区去选另一个项目。而如果该项目确实提供 FastPass 且仍有名额，

cues.en: Bernadotte will grab one and be assigned a return time. The equation that determines Bernadotte's return time is the same one used at the original Fast Pass kiosks.
cues.zh: Bernadotte 就会抢一张，并拿到一个指定的返回时间。决定 Bernadotte 返回时间的计算公式，和当年初代 FastPass 自助取票机上的完全一致。

cues.en: With their spot in the virtual queue secured, Bernadotte can now go back to the hub and repeat their logic over again, deciding whether to do an attraction
cues.zh: 在虚拟排队中锁定名额后，Bernadotte 现在可以返回中心区并重新执行这套逻辑，决定去玩哪个项目

cues.en: attraction or activity to do, but this time, Bernadotte ensures that they will still have time to make it back for their Fastpass. Bernadotte's stay time preference is seven hours, so after they have been at the park for seven hours, they will choose to leave, and their day at Shapeland will be finished. This same logical and preference based progression is repeated for every single guest in the park over the course of the operating day. At the end of each run, the simulation gives me a plethora of data to comb through. Almost everything in my simulation is dynamic.
cues.zh: 或是参加什么活动，但这一次，Bernadotte 会确保自己有足够的时间赶回来用掉 FastPass。Bernadotte 偏好的游玩时长是 7 小时，所以在园区待满 7 小时后，他们就会选择离开，在 Shapeland 的一天也就此结束。在整个营业日里，园区内的每一位游客都会重复这种基于逻辑和偏好的推进过程。每次运行结束时，模拟程序都会给出海量的数据供我梳理。在我的模拟中，几乎一切都是动态的。

cues.en: I can change the number of attractions, attraction capacity,
cues.zh: 我可以调整游乐设施的数量、容量、

cues.en: run time, popularity,
cues.zh: 运行时间、热门程度，

cues.en: and whether each individual attraction has FastPass or not. I can change the behavior archetypes, the park's arrival schedule, and even how many guests are able to utilize the FastPass system. The simulation is by no means perfect, and there are many factors that it does not take into account, such as these.
cues.zh: 以及每个游乐设施是否有 FastPass。我可以调整行为原型、园区到达时间表，甚至有多少游客能使用 FastPass 系统。这个模拟绝非完美，有很多因素它没有考虑，比如这些。

cues.en: I ran the simulation three times, one with no FastPass,
cues.zh: 我运行了三次模拟，一次没有 FastPass，

cues.en: one with the original paper FastPass, and one with the system that simulates FastPass Plus to the best of the simulation's ability. More info on that here. So after obtaining and organizing the results, some fascinating patterns emerged. First, let's discuss what results we will be looking at. Whenever discussing the pros and cons of FastPass, three factors always seem to emerge. Standby wait times, overall wait times, and average number of attractions ridden. Thanks to Shapeland, we finally have answers as to how virtual queue systems affect these results when all other factors remain constant.
cues.zh: 一次使用原始论文的 FastPass，还有一次使用尽可能模拟 FastPass Plus 的系统。更多信息在这里。所以在获取并整理结果后，一些有趣的模式出现了。首先，我们来看看会关注哪些结果。每当讨论 FastPass 的利弊时，似乎总会出现三个因素。普通排队等待时间、总体等待时间，以及平均乘坐设施数量。多亏了 Shapeland，我们终于有了答案，了解在其他因素保持不变时，虚拟排队系统如何影响这些结果。

cues.en: Let's first examine standby wait times. These are the average standby waits for Shape Land's 10 attractions throughout a twelve hour operating day, when there is no fast pass implemented throughout the park. As you can see, we still get huge waits. The triangle has a wait of over three hours, because everybody wants to ride
cues.zh: 我们先来看看普通排队等待时间。这些是 Shape Land 的 10 个游乐设施在 12 小时运营日内的平均普通排队等待时间，此时园区没有实施 FastPass。如你所见，我们仍然看到巨大的等待时间。三角形要等三个多小时，因为每个人都想坐

cues.en: There are two rides, the square and the circle, that have one hour waits, while the hexagon and octagon have no waits and are typically walk ons. Let's see what happens when we add FastPass to the three most popular attractions and operate the park with the original paper FastPass system.
cues.zh: 有两个设施，正方形和圆形，要等一小时，而六边形和八边形无需等待，通常可以直接进入。让我们看看当我们在三个最热门的游乐设施上加入 FastPass，并用原始论文的 FastPass 系统运营园区时会发生什么。

cues.en: Wait times increase for every single attraction. The triangle's average standby wait increases by fifteen minutes. The hexagon is no longer a walk on, but the octagon still is. Now, let's simulate FastPass plus.
cues.zh: 每个景点的等待时间都变长了。三角形的平均排队等待时间增加了十五分钟。六边形不再随到随玩，但八边形仍是。现在，我们来模拟FastPass Plus。

cues.en: Again, every wait time increases, except for one. The standby wait for the most popular ride, the triangle, is twenty minutes less than with the original FastPass system, and five minutes less than with no FastPass.
cues.zh: 同样，每个等待时间都增加了，只有一个例外。最受欢迎的项目——三角形的排队等待时间比原版FastPass系统少二十分钟，比没有FastPass时少五分钟。

cues.en: The reason for this is clear when you look at the wait times throughout the rest of the park. The Octagon, which was a walk on with both no FastPass and the original FastPass system,
cues.zh: 看看园区其他地方等待时间就明白原因了。八边形在无FastPass和原版FastPass下都是随到随玩，

cues.en: now has a fifteen minute wait. The Oval has jumped from a five minute wait with no FastPass to a thirty five minute wait under FastPass plus. Hexagon,
cues.zh: 现在要等十五分钟。椭圆形从无FastPass时的五分钟等待，在FastPass Plus下跃升至三十五分钟。六边形，

cues.en: which was a walk on with no FastPass,
cues.zh: 在无FastPass时随到随玩，

cues.en: now has an hour wait with FastPass plus. This pattern can be seen throughout the park when FastPass plus is added. It is safe to say that overall, both FastPass and especially FastPass plus increases standby wait times throughout a park. The average standby wait with no FastPass was forty one minutes. With FastPass Plus, it is now sixty seven minutes. If FastPass was completely removed from the Walt Disney World parks, wait times would almost certainly decrease.
cues.zh: 在FastPass Plus下现在要等一小时。加入FastPass Plus后，这种模式在全园区都能看到。可以肯定地说，总体而言，FastPass，尤其是FastPass Plus，增加了全园的排队等待时间。无FastPass时平均排队等待为四十一分钟。使用FastPass Plus后，现在为六十七分钟。如果华特迪士尼世界园区彻底取消FastPass，等待时间几乎肯定会减少。

cues.en: But this is not the full story, because many guests are not waiting in the standby line, they're skipping them. Let's now examine the average overall wait. This takes into account both the guests waiting in standby and the guests waiting between five and fifteen minutes in the FastPass line. For our purposes, we're not considering the time in between guests obtaining their FastPass and redeeming it as part of their wait. While in the original FastPass system, guests are technically waiting during this period, their ability to multitask would throw off these calculations, resulting in some guests being able to wait more hours than there are in a day, and it would make FastPass look like it increased waits for everybody, which is not fair to the system. Also, with FastPass plus, how would you even do this? Did this guy wait sixty days to ride seven dwarfs? I guess, technically, but that might throw things off a bit. Anyways,
cues.zh: 但这并非全貌，因为许多游客并不在排队队伍中等待，他们是在跳过排队。现在来看看平均总体等待时间。这包括在排队队伍中等待的游客，以及在FastPass通道等待五到十五分钟的游客。就我们的目的而言，不考虑游客从获取FastPass到兑换使用之间的时间作为等待的一部分。在原版FastPass系统中，游客在这段时间技术上是在等待，但他们能同时做其他事会打乱计算，导致有些游客的等待时间超过一天的小时数，还会让FastPass看起来增加了所有人的等待时间，这对该系统不公平。另外，用FastPass Plus的话，这怎么算？这位老兄等了六十天才坐上七个小矮人矿山车吗？我想，严格来说是的，但那可能会让数据有点失真。总之，

cues.en: the average posted wait in Shapeland with no fast pass is forty one minutes. So if a guest did every attraction in the park in a single day, their average wait per ride would be forty one minutes. However, few guests actually do this, and most gravitate toward the popular attractions. So Shapeland guests actually find themselves waiting, on average, fifty eight minutes per attraction.
cues.zh: Shapeland无FastPass时的平均公示等待时间为四十一分钟。所以如果游客一天内玩遍园区所有项目，每个项目的平均等待就是四十一分钟。然而，很少有游客真这么做，大多数人都涌向热门项目。所以Shapeland的游客实际平均每个项目要等五十八分钟。

cues.en: With the original Paper FastPass,
cues.zh: 使用最初的 Paper FastPass 时，

cues.en: the average posted standby wait was forty eight minutes, but the overall average wait, when factoring in both guest standby line decisions and those skipping the line entirely with FastPass,
cues.zh: standby 排队公布的平均等待时间是 48 分钟，但总体平均等待时间——把游客选择排 standby 队列、以及用 FastPass 完全跳过排队这两种情况都算进去——

cues.en: was only forty minutes,
cues.zh: 只有 40 分钟，

cues.en: eighteen minutes less than without FastPass.
cues.zh: 比没有 FastPass 时少了 18 分钟。

cues.en: But how is this possible?
cues.zh: 但这怎么可能呢？

cues.en: As we've discussed, service rate or capacity is determined mainly by design and operation, and it's nearly impossible to increase an attraction's maximum capacity after it's been constructed.
cues.zh: 正如我们讨论过的，服务速率或容量主要由设计和运营决定，而且游乐项目建成后，几乎不可能再提高它的最大容量。

cues.en: You can't safely put more ride cars on Space Mountain or make it go faster. It wasn't designed for that. So when we add Paper Fast Pass to Shapeland, Shapeland's top rides such as the Triangle and the Square see little to no increase in the number of riders,
cues.zh: 你不能安全地给 Space Mountain 增加更多车辆，也不能让它跑得更快。它并不是为此设计的。所以当我们在 Shapeland 加入 Paper FastPass 后，Shapeland 的顶级项目，比如 Triangle 和 Square，乘坐人数几乎没什么增加，甚至完全没有增加，

cues.en: because they are already serving the maximum number of guests. However, other rides at Shapeland are not operating at maximum capacity.
cues.zh: 因为它们已经在以最大游客量运转。不过，Shapeland 的其他项目并没有满负荷运行。

cues.en: The reason for the increase in the average amount of rides ridden goes back to what Bruce Laval claimed about FastPass backfilling less attended attractions,
cues.zh: 平均乘坐项目数增加的原因，要回到 Bruce Laval 所说的 Paper FastPass 会为客流较少的项目补足客流，

cues.en: and it brings up a new concept within queuing. We know about how capacity and arrival rate can affect a wait time in different ways, but what we have not discussed is the concept of a negative wait time. Now, a wait time cannot be negative in the sense that you can get time back. For instance, I can never give you back the time you've wasted watching this video. What I mean by a negative wait time is that when an attraction is not filling its capacity,
cues.zh: 这也引出了排队理论中的一个新概念。我们知道容量和到达率会以不同方式影响等待时间，但还没讨论过负等待时间这个概念。等待时间不可能为负，意思不是你能把时间拿回来。比如，我永远没法把你浪费在看这个视频上的时间还给你。我说的负等待时间，是指当一个项目没有填满容量时，

cues.en: it is losing capacity.
cues.zh: 它就在损失容量。

cues.en: Look at it this way. Let's say a ride has a capacity of 1,000 guests per hour, but only 500 people per hour ride it. It could be considered that this attraction has a wait time of negative thirty minutes, meaning that thirty minutes worth of people, in this case 500,
cues.zh: 可以这样看。假设一个游乐项目每小时能接待1000人，但每小时只有500人来玩。那就可以认为这个项目有负三十分钟的等待时间，意思是这三十分钟对应的人流，也就是500人，

cues.en: could show up throughout the hour and the attractions wait would still be zero minutes, because these additional guests are merely filling empty seats on the ride. You might recall that this was one of the problems with the original reservation system pitch from the mid nineties. If a guest missed their reservation, they left an empty seat, and thus the attraction lost capacity.
cues.zh: 可以在这一小时内陆续到来，而项目的等待时间仍然是零分钟，因为这些额外的人只是在填补游乐项目上的空座。你可能还记得，这正是九十年代中期最初的预约系统方案存在的问题之一。如果游客错过了他们的预约，就会留下一个空座，项目因此损失了容量。

cues.en: FastPass not only avoids this problem, but it actually helps other attractions at the park. Without FastPass, 1,900 guests rode the Octagon.
cues.zh: FastPass不仅避免了这个问题，实际上还帮助了园区里的其他项目。没有FastPass时，有1900名游客乘坐了Octagon。

cues.en: With paper FastPass,
cues.zh: 有了纸质FastPass后，

cues.en: 4,800 guests rode the Octagon,
cues.zh: 有4800名游客乘坐了Octagon，

cues.en: an increase of over 150%.
cues.zh: 增长了超过150%。

cues.en: But the average posted wait time never breaks zero, because these people are filling empty seats and increasing the capacity of the ride. This explains why with FastPass,
cues.zh: 但平均公布的等待时间从未突破零，因为这些人是在填补空座，提升了项目的容量。这就解释了为什么有了FastPass后，

cues.en: despite most attractions standby waits rising, guests on average waited less. Because unlike with no FastPass, guests were actively being pushed to attractions with zero waits, which dropped the average overall weight per attraction.
cues.zh: 尽管大多数项目的普通排队等待时间上升了，游客平均等待的时间却更少了。因为与没有FastPass时不同，游客被主动引导到零等待的项目，这拉低了每个项目的平均整体等待时间。

cues.en: However, with FastPass plus, this zero weight threshold is broken in most cases, as with the Octagon, which previously went from a walk on to an average of a fifteen minute wait. The average standby wait in Shapeland with FastPass plus is sixty seven minutes, but the overall average wait per attraction was forty two minutes. This is interesting, because while more people are skipping the line more often than with the original FastPass,
cues.zh: 然而，有了FastPass Plus后，这个零等待的门槛在大多数情况下被打破了，比如Octagon，之前是随到随玩，现在平均要等十五分钟。Shapeland在FastPass Plus下的平均普通排队等待时间是六十七分钟，但每个项目的整体平均等待时间是四十二分钟。这很有意思，因为虽然有更多人比原版FastPass时更频繁地跳过排队，

cues.en: the rise and standby waits throughout the park are so significant that there is no change to the overall wait. In fact, the average overall wait per attraction with paper FastPass was two minutes less than FastPass plus. FastPass does reduce average overall wait times by encouraging guests to go to underutilized attractions,
cues.zh: 但整个园区普通排队等待时间的上升如此显著，以至于整体等待时间并没有变化。事实上，纸质FastPass下每个项目的平均整体等待时间比FastPass Plus还少两分钟。FastPass确实通过鼓励游客前往利用率不足的项目来降低平均整体等待时间，

cues.en: so long as those exist.
cues.zh: 只要这些项目还存在。

cues.zh: 最后，我们来看看平均乘坐游乐设施的数量。如果你一直在认真听，应该已经知道答案了。在没有 FastPass 的园区里，游客平均乘坐 3.31

You can also see that around 13% of guests only ride one ride, and 3% ride none. These are mostly people that favor activities and have a limited amount of time in the park. When the original FastPass system is added, the amount of attractions ridden increases,
cues.zh: 个设施。但实际情况，分布是这样的。22% 的游客乘坐两个设施，21% 乘坐三个，16% 乘坐四个，之后比例逐渐下降。你还可以看到，大约 13% 的游客只乘坐一个设施，3% 一个都没坐。这些人大多是偏爱其他活动、在园区里时间有限的游客。加入原版 FastPass 系统后，乘坐设施的数量增加了，

cues.en: going from 3.31
With FastPass plus, we again see an increase, jumping to an average of 4.23

cues.zh: 个设施。平均而言，几乎每位游客都能在新系统下多乘坐一个设施。这很显著，也证明了 FastPass Plus 作为游客分流工具的价值，

cues.zh: 设施，而能体验到可算作合理数量设施的人更少。

cues.zh: 与此同时，

cues.zh: 只玩两个、一个甚至零个游乐项目的游客数量比没有 FastPass 时有所增加，并且远高于理想的 FastPass plus 分布情况。

Other guests want to ride rides, but they don't wanna wait over an hour. So if they enter during midday, they instead choose to eat a meal, gift shop, and then leave because the weights are so high throughout the park. So yes, FastPass and FastPass plus increases the average amount of attractions ridden per guest per day. It's a system that push pushes people to go fill empty seats around the park, and as a guest distribution tool, FastPass and FastPass Plus works.
cues.zh: 这是因为像 Triangle、square 和 circle 这样的项目排队太长了，如果游客选择去排队，就没时间玩别的了。其他游客想玩项目，但又不想等一个多小时。所以如果他们在中午入园，他们宁愿选择吃个饭、逛礼品店，然后就离开，因为整个乐园里的排队时间都太长了。所以是的，FastPass 和 FastPass plus 确实增加了每位游客每天平均游玩项目的数量。这是一个促使人们去填满乐园里空位的系统，作为一个游客分流工具，FastPass 和 FastPass Plus 是起作用的。

cues.en: But in practice, from a guest perspective,
cues.zh: 但在实际操作中，从游客的角度来看，

cues.en: the system benefits those that use the system and know how to use it well, while those that don't use it or don't know how to use it well have it much worse than they did before.
cues.zh: 这个系统对那些使用该系统且深谙其道的人有利，而对于不用或者不太会用的人来说，情况比以前糟糕多了。

cues.en: So at this point, your mid to late two thousand ten's trip to Walt Disney World might have some additional context.
cues.zh: 所以到这时，你在 2010 年代中后期去 Walt Disney World 的旅行，可能就多了一些背景。

cues.en: Perhaps you even know where you land on this distribution graph, and I can probably predict your opinion on the entire subject based on that. If you were here, booking sixty days in advance, and then riding eight or more attractions per day, I imagine that you enjoyed Fastpass Plus. If you were here, not using the system, facing astronomical standby wait times, and thus only experiencing between zero and two attractions per day, you probably didn't like FastPass Plus. Now these two sides might have some opinions on the other. If you didn't use the system to its full effect, you might have been waiting in long standby lines, watching hordes of guests in the FastPass line cut you just because they researched the tips and tricks and were able to pay for an on property hotel.
cues.zh: 也许你甚至知道自己在这张分布图上落在哪里，而我大概能据此预测你对整个话题的看法。如果你当时提前 60 天预订，然后每天玩 8 个或更多项目，我猜你是喜欢 Fastpass Plus 的。如果你当时没用这个系统，面对天文数字般的普通排队时间，因此每天只能玩 0 到 2 个项目，那你大概不喜欢 FastPass Plus。这两拨人可能对对方都有些看法。如果你没有充分利用这个系统，你可能一直在长长的普通队伍里排队，看着 FastPass 通道里成群游客插到你前面，只是因为他们研究过攻略和技巧，而且付得起园区内酒店的钱。

cues.en: Those using FastPass plus to their advantage believed it was those people's fault for doing their research and using the system that was available to everyone, despite that system requiring a certain amount of time, energy, technological literacy, English proficiency, and money for on-site hotels.
cues.zh: 那些利用 FastPass Plus 占优势的人认为，这是那些人自己的错——谁让他们不做功课、不用这个所有人都能用的系统呢，尽管这个系统需要一定的时间、精力、技术素养、英语水平，以及住园区酒店的财力。

cues.en: Even if you benefited and loved FastPass,
cues.zh: 即使你从中受益并且喜欢 FastPass，

cues.en: the truth is that it only worked so well for these people because it worked so poorly for these people. Otherwise, most everyone would be here in the middle. But since this is not the case, a palpable disdain exists between both camps of guests. In queuing theory, this is called Within
cues.zh: 事实是，它对这些人这么好用，只是因为对另一些人那么不好用。否则，大多数人都会处在中间位置。但既然并非如此，两派游客之间就存在明显的鄙视。在排队理论中，这被称为 Within

cues.en: the Disney parks, there has become a class system, just like in the real world, except for this one is silly, mostly inconsequential,
cues.zh: 迪士尼乐园里，已经形成了一种阶级制度，就像现实世界一样，只不过这个制度很荒谬，大多无关紧要，

cues.en: and you aren't forced to live in it like a nightmare you can't wake up from. The class system at the Disney parks, for a long time, wasn't based on money. After the discontinuing of the a through e ticket systems, all guests had equal access as long as they could pay for the price of admission. As we discussed earlier, the in park currency is time, and any advantage came from knowledge. Those that read the guidebooks,
cues.zh: 而且你并不是被迫生活在其中，像一场醒不来的噩梦。迪士尼乐园的阶级制度在很长时间里并不是以金钱为基础的。在 A 到 E 票制取消后，只要付得起门票，所有游客都能平等进入。正如我们之前讨论的，园区内的货币是时间，任何优势都来自知识。那些读过攻略书、

cues.en: knew the parks, and planned their trips had a leg up on other guests. But apart from paying for a tour, guests knew to rush for Space Mountain in the morning, go into the left lane when available, experience the rides with the longest waits during a parade or fireworks,
cues.zh: 了解园区、并提前规划行程的人，比其他游客更有优势。但除了花钱参加导览，游客们知道早上要冲向 Space Mountain，能走左边通道就走左边，在游行或烟花期间去玩排队最久的项目，

cues.en: and so on and so on. In Shapeland, under no fast pass, it takes guests an average of six and a half hours to experience the top six attractions.
cues.zh: 以此类推。在Shapeland，如果没有快速通行证，游客平均需要六个半小时才能体验排名前六的游乐项目。

cues.en: If people showed up earlier in the day, they would have a jump on other guests. But for the most part, there are no hard lines separating visitors.
cues.zh: 如果人们提前到达，就能比其他游客占得先机。但大多数情况下，游客之间并没有硬性的分界线。

cues.en: This was introduced with the original paper FastPass,
cues.zh: 这是随最初的FastPass论文引入的，

cues.en: but this was still a system that was free, with knowledge still being the dividing factor. This is how long it takes on average for a guest to do the top six attractions at Shapeland, but this time with Paper Fastpass.
cues.zh: 但这仍然是一个免费系统，知识仍然是区分因素。这是游客在Shapeland平均需要多长时间体验前六大游乐项目，但这次使用了纸质FastPass。

cues.en: Here we see the different knowledge classes emerge. This is split between those that know the system in and out, those that know how to use the system on a basic level, and those that did not use the system at all. Those that knew the system best could do the six attractions in less than four hours. Those that knew the basics of the system could do the six attractions in six hours, and those that didn't use the system would have to spend eight hours in order to experience the six attractions.
cues.zh: 在这里我们看到不同的知识阶层出现。这分为那些对系统了如指掌的人、那些知道如何基本使用系统的人，以及那些完全没有使用系统的人。那些最了解系统的人可以在不到四小时内完成六个游乐项目。那些了解系统基础知识的人可以在六小时内完成六个项目，而那些不使用系统的人则需要花费八小时才能体验六个项目。

cues.en: Money was reintroduced into the equation with FastPass Plus. Guests that stayed on property would get to book sixty days in advance as a perk of their stay, and if they utilized this perk, they could experience Shapeland's six attractions in less than four hours. Those that understood the system, but had to book within the thirty day window, as opposed to the sixty day window, would have to spend six hours to do Shapeland six attractions.
cues.zh: FastPass Plus将金钱重新引入这个等式。入住度假区的游客作为住宿福利可以提前六十天预订，如果他们利用这个福利，就能在不到四小时内体验Shapeland的六个项目。那些了解系统但只能在三十天窗口内预订而非六十天窗口的人，则需要花费六小时才能完成Shapeland的六个项目。

cues.en: And those that did not use Fastpass Plus at all, would have to spend ten hours on average to do these attractions. And this is not accounting for walking, meals, bathroom breaks, or any other non attraction activity.
cues.zh: 完全没用 Fastpass Plus 的人，平均要花十个小时才能玩这些项目。这还没算上走路、吃饭、上厕所或其他非游乐项目的时间。

cues.en: The disparity between these three systems and their categories of access is staggering,
cues.zh: 这三种系统及其准入类别之间的差距令人震惊，

cues.en: and it showed just how much FastPass plus favored those that got premier access to the system.
cues.zh: 它清楚地显示出 FastPass Plus 有多偏袒那些获得优先准入权的人。

cues.en: But you might be thinking, this doesn't mean anything. Shapeland isn't a real park. These are just fake numbers you made up. But that's not actually true,
cues.zh: 但你可能会想，这说明不了什么。Shapeland 不是真实的乐园。这些只是你编造的假数字。但其实并非如此，

cues.en: because Shapeland is actually Animal Kingdom.
cues.zh: 因为 Shapeland 其实就是动物王国。

cues.en: The triangle is Flight of Passage, the square is Expedition Everest, the circle is Navi River Journey, and so on. More than that, the entire simulation is based off of a specific day at Animal Kingdom,
cues.zh: 三角形是 Flight of Passage，正方形是 Expedition Everest，圆形是 Navi River Journey，以此类推。更重要的是，整个模拟基于动物王国某个特定日期，

cues.en: Saturday, 03/23/2019,
cues.zh: 2019 年 3 月 23 日星期六，

cues.en: a day with medium high crowds. We adjusted the dynamic factors of the system to replicate this day as closely as possible, and then simply turned off FastPass and examined the differences. So all of these results, including this graph, is based off of Animal Kingdom, with the top six attractions being Flight Of Passage, Kilimanjaro Safaris,
cues.zh: 那天的客流量属于中等偏高。我们调整了系统的动态因素，尽可能复现那一天，然后直接关掉 FastPass，再考察差异。所以所有这些结果，包括这张图，都基于动物王国，排名前六的项目是 Flight Of Passage、Kilimanjaro Safaris、

cues.en: Expedition Everest, Navi River Journey, Dinosaur, and Kali River Rapids. For good measure, we also simulated Magic Kingdom and observed the same results.
cues.zh: Expedition Everest、Navi River Journey、Dinosaur 和 Kali River Rapids。为稳妥起见，我们还模拟了魔法王国，观察到了相同的结果。

cues.en: And while the park's more diverse
cues.zh: 而虽然园区更多样化的

cues.en: attractions helped to mitigate the effects of the system in some areas, all of the basic patterns we observed were the same as with Animal Kingdom.
cues.zh: 景点有助于在某些区域缓解该系统的影响，但我们观察到的所有基本模式都与 Animal Kingdom 相同。

cues.en: So this disparity is real and has created rigid categories of preference among park guests. While the system does not treat everyone the same, it should be noted that not all of Walt Disney World's guests are the same. For instance, you have families that save up for a once in a lifetime trip to the resort. You have regular vacationers that come every year or two, and then you have annual pass holders that might go multiple times a month. Many argue, with good reason, that a system that gives preference to these once in a lifetime vacationers is necessary,
cues.zh: 所以这种差异是真实存在的，并在园区游客中形成了固化的偏好类别。虽然系统并没有对所有人一视同仁，但要注意，Walt Disney World 的游客并不都一样。比如，有些家庭会攒钱来度假区进行一次一生一次的旅行；有每隔一两年就来的常客；还有可能一个月来多次的年卡持有者。很多人有充分理由认为，有必要让系统优先照顾这些一生一次的游客，

cues.en: and a system with a distribution like this might seem like the solution. While a distribution graph like this might seem like it's treating everyone almost too equally.
cues.zh: 而采用这种分布的系统看起来像是解决方案。虽然这样的分布图看起来几乎把每个人都平等对待得过头了。

cues.en: However, this conclusion ignores many factors we've learned about queuing, such as capacity and demand.
cues.zh: 然而，这个结论忽略了我们从排队中学到的许多因素，比如容量和需求。

cues.en: Let's use an analogy. So there is a company that makes shoes, and you have two potential customers.
cues.zh: 我们来打个比方。有一家制鞋公司，有两个潜在客户。

cues.en: Customer one really wants the shoes. Customer two does not feel strongly about the shoes. If the shoe company offered the shoes for $30,
cues.zh: 客户一非常想要这双鞋。客户二对这双鞋没有特别强烈的感觉。如果鞋子公司以 30 美元出售这双鞋，

cues.en: customer one would buy them, because they really want the shoes. And since $30 is a great deal for a pair of shoes, customer two would buy them as well. However, if the shoes cost $100,
cues.zh: 客户一会买，因为他们真的很想要这双鞋。而且既然 30 美元买一双鞋很划算，客户二也会买。然而，如果这双鞋要 100 美元，

cues.en: customer one would still buy them, because they really want the shoes. But since customer two doesn't feel strongly about them, they would pass on the offer. Now let's say the shoe store offered customer two the shoes for $30,
cues.zh: 客户一仍然会买，因为他们真的很想要这双鞋。但客户二对它们没有特别强烈的感觉，所以会放弃这个报价。现在假设鞋店以 30 美元把鞋卖给客户二，

cues.en: while offering customer one the shoes for $200.
cues.zh: 而向客户一开价 200 美元。

cues.en: Customer two would take their offer, despite not caring for the shoes, and customer one would also take their offer, because they really want the shoes. Rather than simply using supply and demand to find a fixed price to maximize profits, many companies will find ways to maximize profits via price discrimination,
cues.zh: 顾客二虽然不喜欢这双鞋，但仍会接受报价；顾客一也会接受，因为他真的很想要这双鞋。许多公司不是单纯依靠供需关系来定一个固定价格以实现利润最大化，而是会通过价格歧视来最大化利润，

cues.en: Replacing the programs would be the long anticipated Genie app. The Genie app would use all of Disney's internal data, as well as guest preferences, to intelligently plan itineraries in order to maximize efficiency throughout the parks. Unlike FastPass plus, Genie is simple. cues.en: And hugely popular. Or is it? Who's to say? There were rumors that paid FastPass long before the pandemic, since Disneyland, Hong Kong Disneyland, Disneyland Paris, and Shanghai Disneyland all utilized some form of a paid FastPass system. And with the introduction of Genie Plus, Tokyo Disneyland is now the only remaining park to utilize free FastPass, still using a combination of paper and digital passes. There's two ways to look at this change, the optimistic version and the pessimistic version. The optimistic version is that Disney is once again trying to improve everyone's enjoyment of the parks, This time by reducing the amount of people using the fast pass system. If this occurs, it will reduce standby wait times while giving once in a lifetime vacationers the option to experience more. The fact that they are using the max pass model of only allowing guests to book passes day of seems to be a deliberate attempt to reduce the negative side effects caused by FastPass Plus. Combining this with rising ticket prices, which reduced demand, and a park reservation system to place a cap on guests and predict how many guests will visit, Disney now has more control over crowds than ever. Plus, the Genie app suggestion and itinerary tools will be able to reproduce some of the positive distribution features of FastPass plus by directing guests to underutilized areas of the park, and it could even increase the average number attractions per day. The pessimistic version is that Disney wants money. They increase ticket prices not to reduce demand and lower crowds, but because they can. They're not charging for fast pass to get less people to use the system, they're charging for it because they can. The $15 price for Genie Plus seems to be a good indication that Disney expects a majority of vacationers to buy into the system. And if utilization remains anywhere close to FastPass Plus, every travel agent and vacation guide will suggest that their travelers buy into the system, because $15 to experience all of the rides in one day is a lot cheaper than spreading out a park visit over two or more days. The paid FastPass system also gives Disney more motivation than ever to inflate wait times, and favor lightning lane over standby, with the job of a cast member at the merge point becoming even more difficult. The truth might be somewhere in the middle of these two outlooks. Disney understands they need to reduce usage of Fast Pass Plus, and rather than getting rid of it, they choose the option that also makes them money. So far, amount of passes offered seems somewhat limited, with lightning lane on popular attractions running out quickly in the morning, but who knows if this will remain the case. As with FastPass and FastPass Plus, the true effects of the new system likely will not be seen for quite some time.
cues.zh: 而且极受欢迎。或者，真的如此吗？谁说得准呢？早在疫情爆发前，关于付费 FastPass 的传言就已甚嚣尘上，毕竟加州迪士尼、香港迪士尼、巴黎迪士尼以及上海迪士尼都采用了某种形式的付费 FastPass 机制。而随着 Genie+ 的推出，东京迪士尼成了唯一还在提供免费 FastPass 的乐园，并且依然结合了纸质票和电子票两种形式。看待这种变化有两种视角：乐观视角和悲观视角。乐观的看法是，迪士尼再次试图提升所有人在乐园中的游玩体验，而这一次的做法是减少使用 FastPass 系统的人数。如果真能做到，它将缩短常规排队的等待时间，同时让那些难得来一次的游客有机会体验更多项目。他们采用类似 MaxPass 的模式——只允许游客在游玩当天预约通行证，这显然是有意为了减少 FastPass+ 带来的负面影响。再加上通过上涨门票来抑制需求，以及用入园预约系统设定客流上限并预测游客人数，迪士尼对客流量的掌控力达到了前所未有的水平。此外，Genie App 的推荐和行程规划工具，能够将游客引导至园内人流较少的区域，从而复现 FastPass+ 在人流分流上的积极作用，甚至可能提高游客每天平均游玩的项目数量。而悲观的看法是，迪士尼纯粹就是为了赚钱。他们涨门票根本不是为了抑制需求、减少客流，仅仅是因为他们有能力这么做。他们给 FastPass 收费也不是为了减少使用人数，同样是因为他们能收，所以就收。Genie+ 定价 15 美元，似乎充分说明迪士尼预期大多数游客都会为此买单。而且如果它的使用率哪怕只是接近 FastPass+，各大旅行社和旅游攻略也都会建议游客购买，因为花 15 美元在一天内刷完所有项目，比把行程分散到两天或更长时间要划算得多。付费 FastPass 机制还让迪士尼有了空前的动力去虚标等待时间，并偏袒 Lightning Lane 优先于常规排队，这也让合并点演职人员的工作变得更加艰难。真相可能介于这两种观点之间。迪士尼明白他们需要减少 FastPass+ 的使用量，但与其直接取消，他们选择了既能达标又能赚钱的做法。目前来看，发放的通行证数量似乎有所限制，热门项目的 Lightning Lane 在早间很快就会被抢光，但谁也不知道这种情况是否会一直持续。就像当年的 FastPass 和 FastPass+ 一样，新系统的真正影响恐怕在很长一段时间内都无法盖棺定论。

cues.en: and this long, winding narrative shines a light on an oft overlooked aspect of the theme park industry. We have examined ad nauseam the ways in which Imagineers and theme park designers create immersive worlds that transport guests out of their reality and into a new one, but the story of Fastpass is one of the rare tales that belongs not to
cues.zh: 而这段漫长曲折的叙事，揭示了主题公园行业中一个常被忽视的方面。我们已经反复研究过幻想工程师和主题公园设计师如何创造沉浸式世界，将游客从现实中传送到一个新世界，但快速通行证的故事却是一个罕见的、不属于……

cues.en: operations. If the Imagineers' job is to design and construct environments that entertain and immerse guests, it is the job of operations managers, cast members, and industrial engineers to operate and maintain these environments, and their job is more involved in a park's escapism than one might initially think. When operations find strategies and test systems that have the potential to take the guest experience to the next level, they are not merely increasing guest satisfaction, but they are supporting the environments and stories of the parks by offering a higher level of escapism.
cues.zh: 运营。如果幻想工程师的工作是设计和建造娱乐并沉浸游客的环境，那么运营经理、演职人员和工业工程师的工作就是运营和维护这些环境，而他们的工作在乐园的逃避现实方面，比人们最初想象的要深入得多。当运营部门找到有潜力将游客体验提升到新水平的策略并测试系统时，他们不仅仅是在提高游客满意度，更是在通过提供更高层次的逃避现实来支撑乐园的环境和故事。

cues.en: There is no better example of this than Fastpass.
cues.zh: Fastpass 就是最好的例子。

cues.en: Long lines have always been a disruptive force in the Disney parks, detracting from the guest experience and often the design intentions of the park's theming. After all, the real world has lines at the bank, at restaurants,
cues.zh: 排长队一直是迪士尼乐园的破坏性因素，既损害游客体验，也常常违背园区主题设计初衷。毕竟现实世界里，银行要排队、餐厅要排队，

cues.en: at the DMV.
cues.zh: 车管所也要排队。

cues.en: Attempting to remove them, or at least giving guests the ability to avoid them, has the potential to create an experience better than reality, thus assisting in the escapism and immersion of the parks. However, with the evolution of Fastpass,
cues.zh: 试图消除排队，或至少让游客有能力避开排队，就有可能创造出比现实更美好的体验，从而帮助主题乐园营造逃离现实、沉浸其中的氛围。然而，随着 Fastpass 的演变，

cues.en: we also saw the opposite side of this coin. Instead of operations creating a reality better than ours, the disparities and inequalities of the real world were allowed to creep in. Whether guests were separated by knowledge specific to the park or their personal financial situation,
cues.zh: 我们也看到了硬币的另一面。运营者本应创造比现实更美好的世界，但现实中的差距与不平等却悄然渗入。无论游客是被园区专属知识所区隔，还是因个人经济状况而不同，

cues.en: utilizing a system that allows for these disparities can take away from the intention,
cues.zh: 使用一个允许这些差距存在的系统，会削弱主题乐园体验的本意、

cues.en: uniqueness,
cues.zh: 独特性

cues.en: and beauty of the theme park experience.
cues.zh: 和美感。

cues.en: This is not to say that these strategies weren't worth experimenting with, and I'm sure that we'll see many more in the future. As we know, queuing is always evolving, and no one knows for sure what the next step will be. But what does seem certain is that as long as there is something worth waiting for, there will probably be a wait for it.
cues.zh: 这并不是说这些策略不值得尝试，我相信未来还会出现更多。众所周知，排队方式一直在演变，没人能确定下一步会是什么。但似乎可以确定的是，只要还有值得等待的东西，就很可能需要等待。

cues.en: So I'll ask you again, how much do you know about lines?
cues.zh: 所以我再问一次：你对排队了解多少？
